ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis Project
ns2:course.description: The design, execution, and production of a culminating choreographic/performance project. No graduate credit. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: DANC 362 and senior standing in Dance.
